title: Blue Origin New Glenn Launch Delayed to 2027
excerpt: Blue Origin's New Glenn rocket launch faces continued delays stretching into 2027 following slow repair progress after an earlier explosion.
body_html: Blue Origin's upcoming launch of its New Glenn rocket has been delayed further, with the schedule now stretching into 2027. According to the latest reports, the postponement is due to slow repair progress following an explosion that occurred earlier in the year.
